integrity: The all-modulus proof is analytic. Exact symbolic and cyclotomic computations through N=40 are corroborative only. The determinant factorization is treated as a classical mechanism, not as a novelty claim.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the four DFT rows {0,1,2,4}. It does not classify arbitrary four-row subframes or solve the general composite-size full-spark problem. The odd prime-power full-spark subcase is already implied by Alexeev-Cahill-Mixon; the all-modulus special-family classification and exact bad-minor geometry are the asserted contribution.
title: Exact singular minors for the near-consecutive four-row harmonic frame
